name: reach-next-run-test
description: Sets up a test of one change over your next runs, with the change you will make, what you expect and why, what you will count, how many runs before you look and what would make you keep it or drop it. Use for "run reach-next-run-test", "next run test", "test one change", "improve my outreach", "A/B test my cold email", "what should I change in my outreach", "try a different approach", "experiment with my outreach", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
